welcome.line: Drop an archive on the window to open it, or files and folders to pack them.

drop.hint: Let go: an archive opens, anything else goes into a new archive

opening.title: Reading the list of the archive…

browser.preparingDrag: Getting the files ready to drag…

preview.title: Preview
preview.none: Choose a file to look at it without extracting
preview.truncated: The start of the file is shown

place.named: A new folder named after the archive, next to it
place.beside: The folder the archive is in

symlinkKind.extract: Create when they stay inside the folder

create.title: New archive
create.solid: Compress the files together: a smaller archive, slower access to one file
create.encryptNames: Hide the names of the files too
create.replaceAsk: {path} already exists. Replace it with the new archive?

repair.title: Repair
repair.lead: What still reads is written into a new archive. The damaged one stays as it is.
repair.replaceAsk: {path} already exists. Replace it with the repaired archive?

question.conflictAll: The same for every file that follows
question.symlinkText: The archive holds a symbolic link. Create it?

settings.title: Settings
settings.modePortable: Portable: settings are kept next to the program
settings.modeInstalled: Regular: settings are kept in the user profile

files.changed: {name} was changed. Put it back into the archive?

update.title: Updates
update.idle: BoxIt reaches for the network only when this button is pressed.
update.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and verified. It is installed once the operations finish.
update.failedCheck: The check for updates failed. The log has the details.
update.failedInstall: Version {version} could not be installed. The log has the details.
update.portable: A portable copy does not replace itself: a new one is on the release page.

cli.listSummary: Files: {files}, folders: {folders}, size: {size}. The {format} archive takes {packed}
cli.listSolid: The files are compressed together: taking one out means unpacking the ones before it
cli.listEncrypted: Entries marked with * are protected by a password
cli.extracted: Extracted into {path}. Files: {files}, folders: {folders}, links: {links}, size: {size}
cli.testedDamaged: Damaged files: {count}. Files without errors: {files}, size: {size}
cli.testedPartly: The files of this archive are compressed one after another: what comes after the damage could not be read
cli.repairedRebuilt: The list of the archive was rebuilt from the headers of its files
cli.repairedUnchecked: Files locked with a password were copied as they are: {count}
cli.compared: Only in the first: {left}. Only in the second: {right}. Different: {different}
cli.conflict: {path} already exists. [s]kip, [o]verwrite, [r]ename; a capital letter answers for all the files; [c]ancel:
